name: CAMS 1122
title: Elementary Latin II
description: Further study of the essentials of Latin grammar designed to prepare the student to read simple classical Latin prose.
requirement_description: CAMS 1121 or one year of Latin in high school. May not be taken out of sequence after passing CAMS 1123, 1124. May not be taken for credit after passing any 2000-level or above course taught in Latin, or three or more years of high school Latin.
